example.title: Two-storey motel with green doors and a shingled mansard (Cashmere)

brief: A c. 1980 two-storey motel: cream walls with green room doors and trim, a brown shingled mansard roof, a black steel gallery rail and stair, hanging flower baskets and a small courtyard with a green umbrella. One photo. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
